title: •Astromech Shortage
caption: •Astromech Shortage (V)
game_text: Deploy on table. During the power segment of a battle, may use X Force to reduce a starship’s immunity to attrition by X for remainder of turn. Once per turn, may use 2 Force to cancel the game text of a {maintenance} character or a senator for remainder of turn.
lore: Imperial pilots often target astromechs aboard Rebel starfighters in an attempt to prevent hyper-escapes. Scarcity of undamaged astromechs can delay starfighter deployment.

notes: Inline icon is the gold eight-spoked Republic emblem on a black square — tokened {republic} (wiki stub: [Republic]). The slip's bottom-left caption shows a visibly wider gap before '(V)' ('•Astromech Shortage  (V)'); written with a single space. Wiki base page lists the 350 px -decipher-archive gif (also downloaded); used the 745 px ANH-D-astromechshortage.gif which carries a 'D-E1' label. Modern remake is Block-era only (VB1-D-astromechshortage-pre.gif), modern=null. No immunity icon on this slip. | Inline icon is the MAINTENANCE icon per the VS3 cover ICON KEY (not Republic).
